title: Applied Regression (TUM, Modul MA3409)
description: Students will learn how to solve real applied data problems through examples matching real data to theory. They will learn how to program in R and use it for effective data science, including visualization and analysis. Students will gain comprehensive knowledge of the many types of regression models available for solving real-world problems. 5 ECTS, angeboten im Wintersemester, Version 2022w, verantwortet von Ankerst, Donna.
